canonical_statement: For an abelian variety over a number field, an ample symmetric line bundle L, and a closed geometrically integral subvariety X, the geometric points of X of canonical height at most epsilon are Zariski dense in X for every positive real epsilon if and only if X is a translate of an abelian subvariety by a torsion point.
domain_and_universes: universes uPoint uSubvariety uAbelianSubvariety uLineBundle; BogomolovData packages the geometric-point, subvariety, abelian-subvariety, line-bundle, group-law, canonical-height, torsion, and Zariski-density semantic surfaces for an abelian variety over a number field
hypotheses: D represents an abelian variety over a number field
X is closed and geometrically integral
conclusion: The points x in X with canonicalHeight L x <= epsilon are Zariski dense in X for every positive epsilon if and only if X equals a translate t + B for an abelian subvariety B and torsion point t.
formalization_boundary: Pinned mathlib has no abelian-variety, Neron-Tate-height, or algebraic-subvariety API. BogomolovData therefore exposes these source-level notions as typed semantic operations and predicates. It contains no theorem-result field, and BogomolovTarget still asserts the full equivalence.

killed: removed torsion from the special-locus predicate

degenerate_cases: X equal to the whole ambient variety and zero-dimensional geometrically integral X remain included. Empty or non-geometrically-integral loci, nonample heights, nonsymmetric heights, and nontorsion translates are excluded by explicit hypotheses or the special-locus conclusion.
status_boundary: This freezes and elaborates the exact intake-selected Ullmo-Zhang target and distinguishes four structural weakenings. It does not prove either implication, establish an anchor, or claim theorem completion.
